description: This file defines the Zend_Http_Response class, which models an HTTP response message, including status code, headers, body, and utility methods for parsing and decoding responses.

classes.name: Zend_Http_Response
classes.description: Represents an HTTP response message with methods for parsing, decoding, and retrieving response components.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new response object with status code, headers, body, version, and message.

methods.name: isError
methods.description: Checks if the response indicates an error (status code 4xx or 5xx).

methods.name: isSuccessful
methods.description: Checks if the response indicates success (status code 1xx or 2xx).

methods.name: isRedirect
methods.description: Checks if the response indicates a redirection (status code 3xx).

methods.name: getBody
methods.description: Returns the response body after decoding transfer and content encodings.

methods.name: getRawBody
methods.description: Returns the raw response body as received.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the HTTP version of the response.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns the HTTP status code.

methods.name: getMessage
methods.description: Returns the status message associated with the response code.

methods.name: getHeaders
methods.description: Returns all response headers.

methods.name: getHeader
methods.description: Returns a specific header value.

methods.name: getHeadersAsString
methods.description: Returns all headers as a formatted string.

methods.name: asString
methods.description: Returns the entire response as a string.

methods.name: responseCodeAsText
methods.description: Returns the text description for a given response code.

methods.name: extractCode
methods.description: Extracts the response code from a response string.

methods.name: extractMessage
methods.description: Extracts the response message from a response string.

methods.name: extractVersion
methods.description: Extracts the HTTP version from a response string.

methods.name: extractHeaders
methods.description: Extracts headers from a response string.

methods.name: extractBody
methods.description: Extracts the body from a response string.

methods.name: decodeChunkedBody
methods.description: Decodes a chunked transfer-encoded body.

methods.name: decodeGzip
methods.description: Decodes a gzip-encoded response body.

methods.name: decodeDeflate
methods.description: Decodes a deflate-encoded response body.

methods.name: fromString
methods.description: Creates a Zend_Http_Response object from a raw response string.
